newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka hotel stocks up on tourism revival.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka hotel stocks up on tourism revival.

text.p: Shares of Eden Gardens Hotel and Kandy Hotels were up in early Tuesday trade due to strong growth expected in 1997, brokers said.
Eden rose 75 cents, or 8.11 percent, to 10 rupees and Kandy Hotels climbed 50 cents, or 2.33 percent, to 22.
"A revival of tourism in 1997 is expected to lead to good profit growth in hotel sector shares," said a local broker.
Tourist arrivals in the first quarter of 1997 were 17 percent up from the year-earlier period which was affected by Tamil separatist violence.
